q: (A + B)² = A² + 2AB + B² for square matrices A and B.
why: (A + B)² = A² + AB + BA + B². That only equals the usual formula when AB = BA.

q: f(x) = 3x − 2. What is the inverse function?
why: Undo the steps in reverse order: add 2, then divide by 3. f⁻¹ is not the same as 1/f.

q: Two lines with the same slope never meet.
why: Myth. With the same slope AND the same intercept they are the same line, so they meet everywhere.
